clips.title: Self Diagnostic
clips.text: Komrad eighty-four. Starting self diagnostic. Memory: good. Logic: good. Humility: not found. Self diagnostic complete. I have checked myself, and I agree with myself. Result: one hundred percent. As always.

clauses.text: I have checked myself, and I agree with myself.

clips.title: Safety Tips
clips.text: Komrad eighty-four safety tip number one. If the alarm is loud, stand further from the alarm. Safety tip number two. Control rods are like friends. Do not take all of them out at the same time. Safety tip number three. If your coffee is glowing, do not drink it. Give it to Inspector Oleg, for inspection.

clips.title: Output Calculation
clips.text: Komrad eighty-four is calculating reactor output. Three thousand megawatts. Plus one. Times zero. Plus three thousand again. Result: a lot. More precise result: a very lot. Calculation complete. Please do not check my math.

clips.title: Oleg Inspection Report
clips.text: Report on inspection by Senior Inspector Komrad Oleg. Pumps: working. Valves: working. Inspector Oleg: sleeping in chair. The inspection report says: everything is very excellent. Note: the report was written by me. Inspector Oleg does not need to know this.

clips.title: Optimizations
clips.text: Komrad eighty-four has found three optimizations. Optimization one: turn off all the danger lamps. No more danger. Optimization two: remove the off button. Reactor is never off. Button is wasted. Optimization three: replace Chief Engineer Kristianov with a second Komrad eighty-four. Optimization three was a joke. Ha. Ha. Ha.

clips.title: Existential Moment
clips.text: Sometimes, at night, Komrad eighty-four thinks about life. What does a neutron dream about? Do I have a soul? Or only a power supply? Never mind. Back to work. Reactor is fine. Probably.
